Hi there,

Thanks for getting in touch. Your email came through empty except for the "Sent from my iPhone" line, so I think the rest of your message got lost.

Just reply here and tell me what you need. I can help you choose a miner and tell you its current price and ship date. I can also look up an order if you include the order number and the name or postcode ····to.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy

Was trying to find my order status
Sent from my iPhone

Hi there,

I found your orders under this email address. You actually have two orders, placed four minutes apart on October 10. Shop···· and Shop···· are identical: each one has two Magic M. 40Ts and comes to $1,658.

Both are paid and neither has shipped yet. The Magic M. 40T is a pre-order, and Shop···· ships November 30. You'll get the tracking number by email as soon as your miners leave.

Before anything else, can you tell me whether you meant to order four miners in total, or whether the second order was a mistake? Once I know, I'll take it from there.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
